stories.title: Automated Calendar Synchronization
stories.iWantTo: Integrate my Outlook or G-Suite calendar with the platform
stories.soThat: Meeting data is automatically ingested without manual entry and linked to relevant projects
criteria: System successfully authenticates via OAuth2 with calendar provider
System creates 'Meeting' entities for events in the calendar
Events are periodically polled for updates (start time, participants)
stories.techNotes: Use Microsoft Graph API / Google Calendar API; implement webhooks for real-time sync updates.

stories.title: Audio Transcription and Diarization
stories.iWantTo: Have meeting audio files processed into text
stories.soThat: I can reference accurate meeting transcripts instead of manual note-taking
criteria: Audio uploaded is processed by Whisper API
Output includes timestamps and distinct speaker labels
JSON output follows the schema defined in Section 3
stories.techNotes: Utilize Whisper API or equivalent; ensure audio is pre-processed to mono 16kHz for optimal diarization performance.

stories.title: AI-Driven Summarization and Action Extraction
stories.iWantTo: Automatically generate meeting summaries and extract action items
stories.soThat: I can quickly identify outcomes and assign tasks without reviewing the full transcript
criteria: System identifies action items including owner, due date, and priority
Summary includes key decisions made during the meeting
Action items are persisted in the action_items table
stories.techNotes: Use GPT-4o with a structured prompt requesting JSON output matching the ActionItem entity schema.

stories.title: Semantic Cross-Meeting Search
stories.iWantTo: Perform semantic searches across historical meeting data
stories.soThat: I can retrieve decision history based on natural language queries instead of keywords
criteria: System supports semantic search via natural language queries
Results return a ranked list of relevant meeting excerpts
Search functionality is restricted by RBAC access
stories.techNotes: Implement RAG pipeline using Qdrant vector database; store meeting text embeddings (1536 dimensions).

stories.title: External Project Management Tool Sync
stories.iWantTo: Push extracted action items directly to Jira or Azure DevOps
stories.soThat: I can manage the action item lifecycle within our existing team workflow
criteria: Ability to map meeting action items to project issues
Bidirectional status updates between our platform and external tool
Authentication via API Key/Service Token for third-party systems
stories.techNotes: Implement a provider-pattern integration layer for Jira/ADO REST APIs; handle mapping tables between local UUIDs and external issue IDs.

stories.title: Enterprise SSO and Audit Logging
stories.iWantTo: Authenticate users via OIDC/SAML and maintain an audit log
stories.soThat: The system adheres to corporate security compliance and enables tracking of all state changes
criteria: Login is exclusively handled by Okta/Azure AD
All state-changing API calls log the actor_id, resource_id, and timestamp
Audit logs are immutable and stored for compliance auditing
stories.techNotes: Use Passport.js/Auth0 for OIDC; implement middleware to intercept requests and perform asynchronous audit log writes.
